articles.title: Treasury's Bessent sees crypto as America's next tool for keeping the U.S. dollar on top
articles.snippet: Speaking at Ripple's conference, the U.S. Treasury Secretary said the SEC and CFTC action could help fill the gap left by the Clarity Act's failure, while curbing crypto debanking.

articles.title: Robinhood's crypto revenue fell 55% from last year, but topped Street forecasts
articles.snippet: Crypto trading volume fell 38% from year-ago levels, but the firm's overall blockchain business gained traction.

articles.title: CF Benchmarks brings Wall Street pricing infrastructure onchain, including data used by BlackRock
articles.snippet: The new service could help developers build blockchain-based index funds, tokenized portfolios and derivatives using established financial benchmarks.

articles.title: Japan's top yen stablecoin falls short of its target in a disappointing first year
articles.snippet: CEO Noritaka Okabe blamed a 1 million yen per-transaction cap for Type II funds transfer providers, which has slowed corporate adoption.

articles.title: Bitcoin drops below $80,000 as crypto ignores Asian tech rally, Fed meeting begins
articles.snippet: Bitcoin fell 0.4% to around $79,700 since midnight UTC while Asian tech stocks rallied. The DeFi index dropped 1.8%, and the Fed is set to begin a two-day meeting.
